newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian protesters try to storm parliament.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian protesters try to storm parliament.

text.p: Hundreds of anti-government protesters broke through a riot police cordon outside Bulgaria's parliament on Friday in a bid to storm the assembly during a protest to demand early parliamentary elections, witnesses said.

But the protesters pulled back when opposition leaders urged them to withdraw. The opposition supporters had surrounded the parliament in a human chain after the ruling Bulgarian Socialist Party refused to vote on a "salvation declaration" which demanded an early national poll.
